Name: Coffee Cures Exhausted
Author: Jed5729
Description:
This is a small QOL mod that changes the functionality of the game to make Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, Green Tea, and Joja Cola cure the exhausted effect from over exertion

*technically it's any drink that gives you a speed buff, but that's specifically those 4!! y'know because caffeine!
